runs.purpose: Top-level TRNG IP that exposes a neoTRNG entropy generator and a FIFO to a bus: it decodes bus reads/writes to control the generator (enable, FIFO clear), forwards neoTRNG output bytes into an internal FIFO, and returns status (FIFO available, FIFO size, sim mode) and random bytes on bus_rsp_o.
